summary_markdown: The conversation focused on accessing and verifying the functionality of the inventory management module. It was confirmed that the module is merged into 'develop' and can be viewed on staging. A specific issue noted was that buttons for editing facilities are not visible to users. The participants discussed difficulties in finding data, noting that the required data was unavailable on staging but was visible on a sandbox environment.
decisions: The inventory management module is available for review on staging.
action_items: Investigate why facility editing buttons are not visible in the development environment.
